_doc: emu_fixes crop digests (sha256 of the crop's RGB pixels on the fixed build, DeSmuME). 'approved': crops the user has looked at and approved; only these can judge 'fixed'. 'pending': crops captured by a scenario but not yet approved; they judge 'pending' on the build and do not fail the run. Approve with: emu_harness.py fixes-approve --from <run dir> --crops <crop>[,<crop>...] (work/notes/emu_harness.md 'Fix scenarios'). The crop images are game graphics and stay out of git.

bag-hm.screen: bag, TM pocket with HM01 first: the HM label of the first slot

chain-logger-bar.screen: Chain Logger (Key Items -> USE): the (X) INFO plate of its bottom bar

dex-header.screen: Pokedex opened from the field: the JOHTO POKeDEX plate
